name: smoke-mock
description: 第一人称抽烟模拟器：微信小程序与后端基础工程

scripts.build: npm run build:domain && npm run build -w @smoke/api && npm run build -w @smoke/miniprogram
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:domain && npm run build -w @smoke/api && npm run build:mini && node --test tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-miniprogram.mjs
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:domain && npm run dev -w @smoke/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:domain && npm run build -w @smoke/api && npm run db:migrate -w @smoke/api
